settings.text: Step into a world where emerald glow meets soaring melodies and every journey has the power to change youfor good. These storybook destinations capture the heart of tales filled with courage, friendship, and a little unexpected magic—places where imagination takes flight, where unlikely heroes find their path, and where every moment feels touched by something wonderfully extraordinary. From whimsical lands to iconic theatrical streets, each destination invites you to craft a chapter that leaves its mark long after the adventure ends.

settings.heading: Movie World Gold Coast – Wizard of Oz Precinct (Australia)

settings.text:
Follow the yellow brick path into the all-new Wizard of Oz Precinct at Movie World, where whimsical facades, vibrant colours, and immersive attractions bring classic storybook magic to life. Wander through Oz-inspired streets, meet beloved characters, and step into scenes that feel straight from a fairytale—perfect for fans who adore enchanting worlds and theatrical charm.

Step into the world of spellbinding stories and watch the magic of a beloved tale come to life across Universal Studios Parks around the world. In Orlando, experience the Wicked Experience for unforgettable live performances and immersive shows. At Universal Studios Hollywood, celebrate the story for good, where music, magic, and moments of wonder transport you into a world of courage and friendship. In Japan, join The Wicked Celebration and enjoy spectacular entertainment that brings the story to life. Over in Singapore, watch the wonders of the film unfold before your eyes with cinematic experiences that immerse you in this iconic tale.

Experience the dazzling energy of Broadway, where every theatre marquee glimmers like an emerald spell and stories soar to life on stage. From world-famous musicals to intimate theatres tucked along bustling streets, New York offers an unmatched storytelling experience. Catch a performance of Wicked or other spectacular productions, wander the vibrant theatre district, and feel the thrill of live music and dramatic performances that leave a lasting impression. Every visit is a chapter where theatre, magic, and inspiration collide.
